key.name: toggle
key.summary: Open or close the Now Playing view
key.description: The hotkey. GNOME uses Super+M and Super+V for the calendar, so the default adds Shift.

key.name: idle-start
key.summary: Open by itself after this many seconds idle (0: never)
key.description: Only while music plays, never over a fullscreen window or an idle-inhibited session. Keep it below GNOME's own idle delay.

key.name: when-nothing-plays
key.summary: What the hotkey does when nothing plays
key.description: placeholder: open with "Not Playing"; stay-closed: the hotkey does nothing.
